newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PdVSA sees Venezuela November inflation at 2.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: PdVSA sees Venezuela November inflation at 2.7 pct.

text.p: Venezuelan state-owned oil giant Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) forecast Venezuelan November inflation will slow to 2.7 percent from October's 4.2 percent figure.
"Inflation is falling. According to our economists, we're looking at 2.7 percent for this month," PdVSA President Luis Giusti said at an oil conference in Caracas.

Giusti said the projected November figure was very encouraging. Excluding October's upward blip, Venezuelan inflation has fallen every month since a tough series of IMF-inspired reforms were implemented in mid-April.
